claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully lifted off on April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
NASA's Artemis II mission is a 10-day journey.
NASA's Artemis II mission involves four astronauts testing the Orion spacecraft for future lunar landings.
The crew of NASA's Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
Artemis II is a crewed test flight.
The objective of NASA's Artemis II mission is to circumnavigate the Moon and return to test systems for future lunar missions.
The duration of NASA's Artemis II mission is a ~10-day journey.
Live coverage of NASA's Artemis II mission is available through NASA+, YouTube, and various streaming services.
